paragraphs.text: Cisarzim, the Lord of Chaos was the parun of the Gruul Clans , and participated in the Signing of the Guildpact .

He is allegedly the ancestor of Borborygmos , the present-day guildmaster of the Gruul. Although his fate is not detailed in any canonical works it is known that after he died, the parun of the Golgari Swarm , Svogthir , integrated his torso into his corpse-body.
Cisarzim was noted for having wielded an axe known as "Skullhammer".
